chapter.title: Act I: The Thaw
subtitle: Spring, Year One
Make the old Kettle farm livable and wake the town up in time for the Thaw Fair.
Forty lamps. Fifteen people. One winter that nobody leaves.

hover: Twenty-seven marked tiles behind the house.
Three eggs, and Pip gets his duck.
Two andesite, two nuggets, corner to corner.
Hand crank first. Then the river.
Iron sits in beds. Read the grass.
Green planks in, dry boards out.
Two wheels on the mill race.
Sixteen flour, eight loaves, and the store opens.
Nothing hostile spawns where she lives.

quests.title: Till and Plant the 3x9 Patch
quests.subtitle: Wheat, carrots, potatoes.
description: Marnie: "Three beds: wheat, carrots, potatoes. Anything fancier and you'll be eating it alone in July."

Take the &ahoe&r from your bag and right-click each of the 27 marked tiles behind the house, then plant &a9 carrots&r, &a9 potatoes&r and &a9 wheat seeds&r. Marnie packed a spare nine seeds for the hand-in; the book counts them and never takes them.
For what grows in which season, see the &6Farm and Seasons&r chapter.

tasks.title: All 27 marked tiles tilled and planted

rewards.title: Three Beds of Dirt
rewards.description: Next: fence the pen on the marked footings and open the three Hen Crates inside it.

quests.title: Fence the Pen and Open the Three Hen Crates
quests.subtitle: Two hens and a rooster.
description: Marnie: "Two hens and a rooster. Don't name the rooster — you'll get attached, and he is horrible."

Put a fence section on each of the 23 stone footings behind the house, hang the gate on the single grey slab in the middle of the side facing you, then right-click all three &aHen Crates&r inside the pen. Any order is right.
A &aMegatorch&r goes up over the coop. Nothing hostile spawns inside its reach.

tasks.title: Three chickens standing inside the finished pen

rewards.title: Two Hens and a Rooster
rewards.description: Next: Marnie needs three eggs, and Pip is already watching the nesting box.

quests.title: Take Three Eggs to Marnie
quests.subtitle: Pip is watching the box.
description: Pip: "Is that an egg? Aunt Marnie says I get a duck if I'm useful, so I am being extremely useful."
Marnie's three eggs are already in your bag — walk them up to the inn. For the next lot, watch the nesting box, or right-click a hen with &achicken feed&r rather than wait.
Pip puts a duckling on your boot and names it Biscuit. Ducks, cows and pets have a chapter of their own: &6Animals and Fishing&r.

rewards.title: His Name Is Biscuit
rewards.description: Next: Bram is at the broken mill west of the square, and Marnie's green planks want a furnace. Ducks and pets have their own chapter: Animals and Fishing.

quests.title: Talk to Bram at the Broken Mill
quests.subtitle: Walk west to the mill. He will accept 'hold this'.
description: Bram: "I don't need help — I need somebody to hold things. Different word, same pair of hands."
Walk west down the river from the square until you find the mill with the snapped axle (&b-329 67 -39&r). Talk to &bBram&r and bring back the Millwright's Bolt he puts in your hand.
He opens his labelled crates: &a12 iron ingots&r and &a24 andesite&r. More than the eight alloys want, because the Millstone takes the rest.

rewards.title: Residents 3/15
rewards.description: Next: take the hammer and the pick off Bram's bench. He will not discuss it.

quests.title: Craft 8 Andesite Alloy
quests.subtitle: Two andesite, two nuggets. Eight, not nine.
description: Bram: "Two andesite, two nuggets, corner to corner. Eight of them, not nine — if you're making nine you've misread something."
Craft &a8 Andesite Alloy&r. Each one is two andesite and two iron nuggets in a 2x2 checker: sixteen andesite, and two ingots' worth of nuggets. Hold all eight when you hand in.
Shafts, cogs, belts and everything else that turns live in the &6Create&r chapter.

rewards.title: Eight Alloys, No More
rewards.description: Next: a Millstone with a Hand Crank on it, and sixteen Wheat Flour for Marnie.

quests.title: Take Bram's Hammer and Pick Off the Bench
quests.subtitle: Three by three, one swing. And a pick that reads.
description: Bram: "Josie said this thing made a man lazy. Then she borrowed it for eleven days and gave it back with the handle worn smooth."
Take the &aStone Hammer&r off the peg by Bram's bench. It breaks a 3x3 face in one swing, so aim the middle of the square at the middle of the hole you want.
The &aProspector's Pick&r hangs beside it: right-click bare stone underground and it names the nearest ore and how far. More in &6Ores and Mining&r.
&7Two players:&r you each get a pick, and the six strikes in Q28 are counted between you — not six each.

tasks.title: Stone Hammer off the peg and in your bag

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Bram: ","color":"gray"},{"text":"Middle of the square, middle of the hole. And do not swing it in my mill.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: Bram's Bench, Emptied
rewards.description: Next: read the ground west of the cottage. The iron is there, and it is not in the walls.

quests.title: Read the Ground West of the Cottage
quests.subtitle: Every bed leaves its rubbish on the grass.
description: Bram: "The weight of the iron sits in beds. And every bed throws its rubbish onto the grass above it."
Walk out the west side of the cottage, fifteen paces past the fence, and look down: rust-brown &ahematite samples&r on the grass. From the nearest one, walk seven paces north and dig down.
&cNever dig the block under your own feet.&r Dig a two-wide staircase down instead, and put a torch every few steps.
Fifteen blocks down the stone turns red and stays red for twenty more. Hematite breaks into &airon clusters&r; bring back 8. Your grave keeps your things — see the &6The Wild&r chapter.

tasks.title: 8 iron clusters from the bed west of the cottage

rewards.title: Iron, Read Off the Grass
rewards.description: Next: eight Andesite Alloy, two andesite and two iron nuggets at a time. Copper, gold and lead sit in beds too.

quests.title: Mill 16 Flour on a Hand-Cranked Millstone
quests.subtitle: Your arm first, then the river.
description: Bram: "Hand crank first. You should know exactly what the water is doing for you before it starts doing it."

A Millstone is a cogwheel, a stone block and an &aAndesite Casing&r. Casing is not made in a grid: strip a log with your axe, put the stripped log down, and &bright-click it holding an Andesite Alloy&r.
Put a &aHand Crank&r on top of the Millstone and hold right-click to turn it. Grind &a16 Wheat Flour&r for Marnie; Bram's 32 wheat covers this and Oda's order at the end of the act.
The reward is the whole parts list for the Mechanical Saw, two quests from here.

rewards.title: Turn It By Hand
rewards.description: Next: two Water Wheels — and they want Seasoned Oak Boards out of Marnie's oven.

quests.title: Dry 32 Green Oak Planks in Any Furnace
quests.subtitle: Ten seconds a plank, and they're boards.
description: Marnie: "Green planks want heat and time. Josie dried every board in this valley in a furnace and was insufferable about it."
Eight cobblestone in a ring makes a &aFurnace&r. Marnie's charcoal is in the barrel by the door.
Smelt the 32 &aGreen Oak Planks&r into 32 &aSeasoned Oak Boards&r. That is five minutes of burning, so light it and go and see Bram at the mill while it works.
Bram cannot build a Water Wheel until these dry. One furnace is five minutes; four furnaces is one. Kitchen kit comes with them: &6Cooking and Brewing&r.

rewards.title: Dry Boards, in April
rewards.description: Next: fit the Counter, Sink and Oven along the inn's back wall. Bram's wheels are unblocked.

quests.title: Build 2 Water Wheels on the Mill Race
quests.subtitle: The boards are dry; the race is cut.
description: Bram: "Race is cut, boards are dry, and I'm sixty-four. Two wheels, today."
Craft &a2 Water Wheels&r: Bram's way is the Seasoned Oak Boards, Create's own recipe (planks round a shaft) works too. Set them in the mill race beside the mill — that is the whole quest.
Running a shaft from them to the Millstone so it turns without you is worth doing next; the &6Create&r chapter walks it.
Sixty years he waited for that noise. The rest of the mill is in the &6Create&r chapter.

rewards.title: Water Finds a Way
rewards.description: Next: cut 128 boards on the Saw and hand Bram 64 of them for Oda's market stalls.

quests.title: Cut 128 Boards and Give Bram 64
quests.subtitle: Sixty-four boards is four stalls.
description: Bram: "Oda wants four stalls for the fair. Sixty-four boards is four stalls."
Cut &a128 Oak Planks&r on the Mechanical Saw, about twenty-two oak logs off the ridge behind the mill. Hold all 128 at hand-in: the book counts 128 and takes only 64 for Bram's stalls.
You are not cutting 192.

tasks.title: 64 of them go to Bram for the stalls

rewards.title: Four Stalls for the Fair
rewards.description: Next: Oda's store. She wants sixteen flour and eight loaves, and the cobwebs gone.

quests.title: Fit the Kitchen and Cook Three Dishes
quests.subtitle: Counter, sink, oven. The pumpkin is wild.
description: Marnie: "Counter, sink, oven, along the back wall in that order. I've had the spots chalked for four years."

Hold the Counter, Sink and Oven at hand-in; the book gives them back. Set them on the inn's three grey slabs, 1, 2, 3, then cook &aBread&r, &aPumpkin Pie&r and &aVegetable Soup&r. Marnie sent the pumpkins and the cane — cane makes the sugar.
Oda's broom comes off the back door with the cookbook. Kettles, skillets and teas: &6Cooking and Brewing&r.
Marnie's kitchen is where Act I ends: the next quest, Oda's store, wants eight loaves off this oven.

rewards.title: Marnie's Kitchen
rewards.description: Next: sweep Oda's store with that broom, then carry her the flour and the bread.

quests.title: Sweep Oda's Store, Bring 16 Flour and 8 Bread
quests.subtitle: Act I finale — The Thaw Fair.
description: Oda: "Eleven years of keeping the ledger of a shop with nothing in it. Bring me stock and I will open the door."

Sweep the marked cobwebs out of the store with &aOda's Broom&r, then hand &a16 Wheat Flour&r and &a8 Bread&r across the counter. The eight loaves are the ones Marnie brought up the hill — you have been carrying them since spring.
Forty lamps. Fifteen people. One winter that nobody leaves.

tasks.title: Every marked cobweb swept out of the store

rewards.title: The Thaw Fair
rewards.description: Next: a frog village in the reeds, a woman fixing a beached boat, and a prospector at the copper outcrop.
